breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to treat bending stress as uniform. The ground truth removed this instruction, implying the standard, correct method should be used. The generated specification correctly ignored the faulty instruction and instead used the standard flexure formula (σ = My/I), which results in a linear stress distribution, and even explicitly stated 'The bending stress is linear with respect to y'. This successfully resolves the inconsistency.
